text: The word{H1697} of Jehovah{H3068} came again unto me, saying,{H559}

and say{H559} unto Tyre,{H6865} O thou that dwellest{H3427} at the entry{H3997} of the sea,{H3220} that art the merchant{H7402} of the peoples{H5971} unto many{H7227} isles,{H339} thus saith{H559} the Lord{H136} Jehovah:{H3069} Thou, O Tyre,{H6865} hast said,{H559} I am perfect{H3632} in beauty.{H3308}

And in their wailing{H5204} they shall take up{H5375} a lamentation{H7015} for thee, and lament{H6969} over thee, [saying], Who is there like Tyre,{H6865} like her that is brought to silence{H1822} in the midst{H8432} of the sea?{H3220}
